notes: Source: Jaguars 2026 media guide, INDIVIDUAL RECORDS (career) pp. 416-423, SINGLE-SEASON RECORDS pp. 424-428, SINGLE-GAME RECORDS pp. 429-432 (the TOC prints 'SINGLE-GAME RECORDS 423-432' but the section starts on p429). PDF page = printed page number. Regular season only; rookie (433-435), opponent (436-437), team (402-415) and playoff (438-443) records were ignored. Franchise began 1995.

through_season 2025: the single-game lists include the 2025 regular season (e.g. 'Trevor Lawrence (Dec. 14, 2025 vs. NYJ)', 'Devin Lloyd (Sept. 28, 2025 at S.F.)') and other pages cite the 2025 finale on 1/4/26; season lists carry '(2025)' rows (e.g. Josh Hines-Allen 2025 in the career list years '2019-25').

Ranks are printed in this guide and are kept as printed. A tie group prints its rank on the first row and leaves the rank cell blank on the other rows; those rows take the first row's rank here and all rows of a group get tie:true (decided by equal values).

Printed-rank irregularities (values transcribed as printed): season passing yards prints rank 2 and rank 3 for the two 4,367 rows and prints rank 5 twice (4,007 and 3,905), so ranks after that are one above the row position; career rushing TDs prints the two 17s as ranks 8 and 9; season sacks leaves the rank cell blank on both 12.0 rows that follow Campbell's 14.5 (rank 2), rank 3 inferred for them from the next printed rank (5).

'Nine players, last: NAME (date)', 'Eight times, last: ...' and 'Several players tied, last: ...' rows (single-game rushing TDs, receptions and receiving TDs) mean N games share that value and only the latest is named: tie:true, NOT a sole record holder.

Name edits (printed typos; raw keeps the printed text, and the correct spelling is printed elsewhere in the same guide): the season rushing-TD list prints 'Muarice Jones-Drew (2008)', name = 'Maurice Jones-Drew'; the single-game sacks list prints 'Kelvin Prichett (Oct. 5, 1997 vs. CIN)', name = 'Kelvin Pritchett' (the guide prints Pritchett in its transactions, alumni and game summaries). Spelling variants printed as is: the career tackles list has 'Jonathan Cyprien (2013-16)' but the single-game tackles list has 'Johnathan Cyprien'. The career rushing-yards list prints 'David Garrard(2002-10)' without a space (raw as printed). Printed '*Led NFL*' notes stay in raw only. Bold type in the guide marks active players (no meaning for the data).
Dates: game lists print '(Sept. 22, 1996 at N.E.)'; the years field holds M/D/YYYY, raw keeps the printed wording. Tackles single-game rows print opponents in mixed case ('vs. Dal.', 'at Hou.').
Where the whole list is one tie group (single-game interceptions: 18 rows at 2) every row is included. Single-game passing TDs includes the nine 4-TD rows (all rank 3 or blank).

Interceptions: the offensive 'Interceptions Thrown' (career p418) and 'Interceptions' (season p425, single-game p429) lists are interceptions thrown by passers and were not used; the DEFENSE lists on pp. 422, 428 and 431 were. Scrimmage/all-purpose yardage and touchdown-total lists were not used.
Tackles: printed for all three scopes under the heading 'Tackles' (DEFENSE section), with no solo/assist split and no official/unofficial note. Sacks are official (franchise began 1995).
